study.notes: STUDY: ESSENCE (NCT04822181), Sanyal 2025 NEJM, part 1 interim analysis of the first 800 of 1197 patients randomised 2:1 (534 semaglutide, 266 placebo), biopsy defined MASH with fibrosis stage 2 or 3, once weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg vs placebo, 72 weeks, multicentre double blind; the group's packet text (proxy capture of the NEJM page) carries the article body without the table bodies, so Table 2 (cardiometabolic features at week 72) and Table 1 were copied from the page through the institutional route into work/fulltext/companion/sanyal2025_essence_tables.txt; the two primary end points are histological (events per arm derived from the printed percentages of the full analysis set, see the row notes); Table 2 gives estimated between group differences in units (dagger rows) and estimated treatment ratios expressed as percentages (double dagger rows, PCT); pct_weight_change -8.5 is the estimated difference in percent body weight change (semaglutide -10.5, placebo -2.0); all end points prespecified (confirmatory secondary end points tested hierarchically); funded by Novo Nordisk (industry_funded TRUE); ALT, AST, GGT, HOMA-IR, PRO-C3, ELF and liver stiffness are reported in the supplement (Tables S6 and S7) and figures, not captured

rows.notes: first primary end point: resolution of steatohepatitis with no worsening of fibrosis at week 72 in 62.9 percent of 534 vs 34.3 percent of 266 (estimated difference 28.7 percentage points, 95% CI 21.1 to 36.2, P < 0.001); events computed by the session from the printed percentages of the full analysis set (0.629*534 = 335.9, 0.343*266 = 91.2; missing histology for 65 and 42 patients handled by the trial's imputation, so the percentages are model based); route events_log_RR gives the log risk ratio

second primary end point: reduction in liver fibrosis with no worsening of steatohepatitis at week 72 in 36.8 percent vs 22.4 percent (estimated difference 14.4 percentage points, 95% CI 7.5 to 21.3, P < 0.001); events computed by the session from the printed percentages (0.368*534 = 196.5, 0.224*266 = 59.6)
Table 2: systolic blood pressure, estimated difference -4.00 (-5.93 to -2.07) mm Hg at week 72; arm changes -5.39 vs -1.39; baseline not in Table 1 (Table S2)
Table 2: diastolic blood pressure, estimated difference -2.14 (-3.43 to -0.85) mm Hg at week 72; arm changes -1.90 vs 0.24
Table 2: high sensitivity C-reactive protein, estimated treatment ratio expressed as a percentage, -42.41 (-49.75 to -33.98) at week 72; arm relative changes -53.83 vs -19.83 percent
Table 2: triglycerides, estimated treatment ratio as a percentage, -16.54 (-21.02 to -11.81); arm relative changes -16.77 vs -0.27 percent
Table 2: total cholesterol, estimated treatment ratio as a percentage, -2.93 (-5.60 to -0.19); arm relative changes -6.03 vs -3.19 percent
Table 2: LDL cholesterol, estimated treatment ratio as a percentage, -2.04 (-6.35 to 2.46); arm relative changes -6.07 vs -4.11 percent

json.design: phase 3 multicentre randomised double blind placebo controlled trial, 2:1, 72 week part 1 interim analysis of the first 800 patients, biopsy defined MASH with fibrosis stage 2 or 3
json.reason: full text group (proxy capture); the table bodies were copied from the NEJM page through the institutional route
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: ALT and AST (supplement Table S6, Fig. S9)
other_markers: HbA1c reported only by diabetes status subgroup: without type 2 diabetes -0.53 (-0.61 to -0.44), with type 2 diabetes -1.08 (-1.27 to -0.89) percentage points

rob.justification: S: randomised double blind (D1, D2 low); primary histology missing for 12.2 and 15.8 percent, handled by prespecified imputation (D3 some concerns); central pathology reading and laboratory outcomes (D4 low); prespecified hierarchical testing, registered (D5 low)

doubts: HbA1c is given only by diabetes status (without type 2 diabetes -0.53 (-0.61 to -0.44); with type 2 diabetes -1.08 (-1.27 to -0.89) percentage points) and no overall row; neither subgroup is extracted because the subgroup n are not given
binary end point events are derived from printed percentages of the full analysis set, not from counts
baselines for blood pressure and lipids are in Table S2, not captured
